issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: CROON
products.tagline: Live dubbing for whatever's playing on your iPhone
products.summaryZh: 为iPhone上播放的任何内容提供实时配音
products.descriptionZh: CROON 在 iPhone 上播放视频或音频时，将其同步配音成你的语言，声音接近原说话者。它在你已使用的应用之上运行。开启 CROON 一次，然后返回你的应用继续观看。多人同时说话时，每个人保持各自独立的声音。免费下载。
products.description: CROON dubs video or audio on your iPhone into your language as it plays, in a voice close to the speaker's. It works on top of the apps you already use. Turn CROON on once, then go back to your app and keep watching. When multiple people are talking, each keeps a separate voice. Free to download.

products.name: Fenna Crew
products.tagline: Grok Bot, but open source and on your Claude Code plan
products.summaryZh: Grok Bot，但开源，并且可在你的 Claude Code 计划中使用
products.descriptionZh: Grok Bot 展示了拥有自己电脑的机器人能做什么。Fenna Crew 是开源版本，运行在你的机器上，并使用你已付费的 AI：Claude Code、Codex 或 Antigravity。给机器人一项任务和一个时间表。它在自己的浏览器、文件和文档、表格和幻灯片编辑器中工作，绝不碰你的。你可以观察它，接管以输入密码，它在做任何有风险的事之前会先询问。无需账户，免费，AGPL。
products.description: Grok Bot showed what bots with their own computer can do. Fenna Crew is the open source version that runs on your machine and uses the AI you already pay for: Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity. Give a bot a job and a schedule. It works in its own browser, files and docs, sheets and slides editors, never yours. Watch it, take over to type a password, and it asks before anything risky. No account, free, AGPL.

products.name: AEO Growth
products.tagline: Get more customers from AI answers
products.summaryZh: 从AI回答中获取更多客户
products.descriptionZh: 你的客户现在会问 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Claude 和 Google AI 该从谁那里购买，并且信任听到的答案。AEO Growth 确保那个答案是你。你会看到自己目前在 AI 回答中出现的位置、与竞争对手相比处于什么水平，以及是什么在阻碍你。然后我们的团队从头到尾处理每一项修复。从免费 AI 扫描开始。
products.description: Your customers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude and Google AI who to buy from, and they trust what they hear. AEO Growth makes sure the answer is you. You'll see where you show up in AI answers today, how you stack up against your competitors, and what's holding you back. Then our team takes care of every fix, start to finish. Start with a free AI scan.

products.name: Subnano
products.tagline: Where people and AI agents buy and sell digital work
products.summaryZh: 人与AI代理买卖数字工作成果的地方
products.descriptionZh: Subnano 是一个市场，人们和 AI 代理在这里买卖数字作品：数据集、研究、工具和文章，其中许多附带可下载的文件。按篇用 Nano 或 USDC 支付，无需订阅。连接 Claude Code、Codex 或其他 MCP 客户端，你的代理便可在你设定的限额内搜索、比较价格并购买，或通过 HTTP 使用 x402 支付。卖家每笔销售的收入直接进入自己的钱包。找不到所需内容？发布一条 Request，附上需求说明和预算。
products.description: Subnano is a marketplace where people and AI agents buy and sell digital work: datasets, research, tools and articles, many with files to download. Pay per post in Nano or USDC, with no subscription. Connect Claude Code, Codex or another MCP client, and your agent can search, compare prices and buy within a limit you set, or pay over HTTP with x402. Sellers are paid to their own wallet on every sale. Can't find it? Post a Request with a brief and a budget.

products.name: Intraface
products.tagline: Let your Claude Code and your team's work from one board
products.summaryZh: 让你的 Claude Code 和团队工作汇聚于同一看板
products.descriptionZh: Intraface 为你的团队提供一个链接上的实时 HTML 页面。把链接粘贴到 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot 或 Gemini CLI 中。智能体会拉取最新版本和看板规则（collab.md），编辑自己的副本并发布回去。每个看板有发布队列，合并到最新版本，并以本人和智能体的名义落地。在实时页面上固定评论，智能体会读取并解决它们。免费开始。
products.description: Intraface gives your team one live HTML page on one link. Paste the link into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot or Gemini CLI. The agent pulls the latest version and the board's rules (collab.md), edits its own copy and publishes back. Publishes queue per board, merge onto the latest version and land with the person's and the agent's name. Pin comments on the live page and agents read and resolve them. Free to start.

products.name: Merrin: Private Personal AI
products.tagline: Private personal AI that remembers you, fully on-device
products.summaryZh: 私密个人AI，记住你，完全在设备上运行
products.descriptionZh: Merrin 是一款基于本地 AI 的私密个人智能助手，适用于你的手机和电脑。你可以通过语音或文字谈论任何心中所想，也可以给它看一张照片。它会记住你提到的人、计划和细节，自动将重要的对话转化为条目，并帮助你发现自己思维中的模式。AI 模型在你的设备上本地运行：无需账户，不依赖云端 AI，下载后即可离线使用。通过端到端加密同步，将你的手机和桌面设备配对。
products.description: Merrin is a private personal intelligence built on local AI, for your phone and computer. Talk or type about anything on your mind, or show it a photo. It remembers the people, plans and details you mention, turns meaningful chats into entries on its own, and helps you see patterns in your own thinking. The AI model runs locally on your device: no account, no cloud AI, and it works offline once downloaded. Pair your phone and desktop with end-to-end encrypted sync.

products.name: Vybscan
products.tagline: Comprehensive secure SDLC: SAST, SCA, DAST, cloud posture
products.summaryZh: 全面的安全SDLC：SAST、SCA、DAST、云态势
products.descriptionZh: 面向AI编写代码的AI代码安全扫描器，在GitHub和GitLab的拉取请求和推送中提供SAST、DAST、SCA、密钥、IaC、许可证和误植域名扫描。为Frappe等不受支持的框架提供特别支持。
products.description: AI code security scanner for AI-written code, with SAST, DAST, SCA, secret, IaC, license, and typosquat scanning on GitHub and GitLab pull requests and pushes. Provides special support for unsupported frameworks such as Frappe.

products.name: SpeechScroller
products.tagline: The free teleprompter that scrolls with your voice
products.summaryZh: 随声滚动的免费提词器
products.descriptionZh: SpeechScroller 是一款免费的提词器，能跟随你的声音滚动。粘贴脚本，按下开始，然后大声朗读。它会滚动到你当前的位置，在你停顿时等待，在你跳读时跟上。包含用于提词器玻璃的镜像模式、可调文字大小、屏幕注释和实时每分钟字数。无需下载，无需注册，你的脚本保留在浏览器中。
products.description: SpeechScroller is a free teleprompter that follows your voice. Paste your script, press start, and read out loud. It scrolls to wherever you are, waits when you pause, and catches up if you skip ahead. Includes mirror mode for teleprompter glass, adjustable text size, on-screen notes, and live words per minute. No download, no signup, and your script stays in your browser.

products.name: Brisano
products.tagline: Track your brand in AI answers and see exactly what to fix
products.summaryZh: 在AI回答中追踪你的品牌，准确了解需要修正什么
products.descriptionZh: 买家现在会问 ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Google AI 该选哪个工具。Brisano 会按计划向最多 8 个 AI 引擎提出买家所问的问题，并显示你是否被提及、以什么位置出现、谁替代你出现，以及 AI 引用了哪些来源。每个回答都会连同引擎、方法和日期一并保存。从第一天起，它就把差距转化为行动：需要加入的清单、需要发布的页面，以及可直接复制代码的网站修复项。免费检查器，无需注册。
products.description: Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI which tool to pick. Brisano asks up to 8 AI engines the questions your buyers ask, on a schedule, and shows if you're named, in what position, who appears instead and which sources the AI cited. Every answer is saved with engine, method and date. From day one it turns gaps into actions: lists to get on, pages to publish and site fixes with code ready to copy. Free checker, no signup.

products.name: ChristmasMac
products.tagline: Christmas lights, playable snow and an elf for your Mac
products.summaryZh: 圣诞彩灯、可玩的雪景，还有为你的Mac准备的小精灵
products.descriptionZh: ChristmasMac 为你的 Mac 增添节日装饰。彩灯悬挂在窗口和 Dock 上，拖动窗口时随之摆动，还能随音乐舞动。雪花在窗口上堆积：可以拂去雪花，滚成雪球投掷。圣诞老人不时飞过，你设计的小精灵住在桌面上的红色小屋里，还能一步步堆出雪人。另有唱片机、便签、时钟、倒计时和 12 款手绘壁纸。一次性付费 $9.99，每年圣诞都属于你。
products.description: ChristmasMac decorates your Mac for the holidays. Lights hang on your windows and Dock, swing when you drag a window and dance to your music. Snow piles up on your windows: brush it off, roll it into snowballs and throw them. Santa flies over now and then, an elf you design lives in a little red cabin on your desktop, and you can build a snowman click by click. Plus a record player, notes, a clock, a countdown and 12 painted wallpapers. $9.99 once, yours every Christmas.

products.name: WatchLog
products.tagline: Your watch collection, every watch's drift and a timegrapher
products.summaryZh: 你的腕表收藏，每一枚腕表的走时误差与一台校表仪
products.descriptionZh: WatchLog 将你的机械表收藏集中一处，并追踪每只表的走时精度。以 3D 绘制的方式添加每只表，一眼即可看到其走时偏差。当秒针到达标记时轻点：读数会以原子钟时间标记，并按每日秒差绘制成图表，对照 COSC、METAS 及其他 18 项标准。内置校表仪通过麦克风读取走时速率、节拍误差和摆幅，无需额外硬件。支持 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac。免费支持三只表，无需账户，无广告。
products.description: WatchLog keeps your mechanical watch collection in one place and tracks the accuracy of every watch in it. Add each watch, drawn in 3D, and see its drift at a glance. Tap as the seconds hand hits the mark: the reading is stamped with atomic time and charted in seconds per day against COSC, METAS and 18 other standards. The built-in timegrapher reads rate, beat error and amplitude through the microphone, no extra hardware. iPhone, iPad and Mac. Free for three watches, no account, no ads.

products.name: Dawnroom
products.tagline: Make and edit images on your own GPU. No credits, no cloud
products.summaryZh: 在你自己的GPU上制作和编辑图像。无需积分，无需云端。
products.descriptionZh: Dawnroom 是一个开源图像工作室，运行在你自己的 GPU 上。描述一张图像，得到一张图像。描述一处修改，它只编辑该处，其余部分保持不变。自动模式会挑选适合你机器的模型，模型库中有 34 个开源模型，所有数据都不会离开你的电脑。你可以使用 Windows Studio、CLI、本地 OpenAI 兼容 API，或 MCP 服务器，让 Claude Code 和 Codex 为你生成图像。
products.description: Dawnroom is an open-source image studio that runs on your own GPU. Describe an image, get an image. Describe a change, and it edits the rest untouched. Auto mode picks a model that fits your machine, 34 open models are in the library, and nothing leaves your computer. Use the Windows Studio, the CLI, a localhost OpenAI-compatible API, or an MCP server so Claude Code and Codex can generate images for you.

products.name: Pratico
products.tagline: Fast and secure containers for MacOS, agent and docker aware
products.summaryZh: 适用于MacOS的快速安全容器，支持代理和Docker感知
products.descriptionZh: Pratico 在你的 Mac 上，利用 Virtualization Framework，在各自隔离的轻量级虚拟机中运行容器，并置于你和你的工具已在使用的 Docker 兼容 API 之后。镜像在拉取时和每日都会扫描，发现问题即阻止，以防供应链和安全问题。出站连接会被命名，并对照威胁情报源进行检查；轻量记录器会记录每个容器运行了什么。Agent 会获得一个用于一次性虚拟机的 MCP 端点，而询问模式会暂缓每个新目的地，直到你允许。
products.description: Pratico runs containers in their own isolated lightweight VM on your Mac, using the Virtualization Framework. behind a Docker-compatible API that you and your tools already use. Images are scanned on pull, daily and blocked on findings to prevent supply chain and security issues. Outbound connections are named and checked against threat feeds; light recorder logs what each container ran. Agents get an MCP endpoint for throwaway VMs, and ask mode holds each new destination until you allow it.

products.name: ReelHatch
products.tagline: AI UGC ads from a prompt or a link, in minutes
products.summaryZh: 从提示或链接生成AI UGC广告，几分钟即可完成
products.descriptionZh: ReelHatch 为 TikTok、Instagram Reels 和 YouTube Shorts 制作成品 UGC 风格视频广告。输入提示词、粘贴产品链接或添加照片，AI 导演会撰写脚本、挑选并配音出镜者、添加字幕和音乐，然后在约 9 分钟内拍摄并剪辑广告。一键发布或下载 MP4。注册前即可看到价格，还可通过 ReelHatch 连接器在 Claude、ChatGPT 或 Cursor 中制作广告。
products.description: ReelHatch makes finished UGC-style video ads for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Type a prompt, paste a product link or add photos, and an AI director writes the script, casts and voices the presenter, adds captions and music, then shoots and cuts the ad in about 9 minutes. Post it in one click or download the MP4. You see the price before you sign up, and you can make ads from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor through the ReelHatch connector.

products.name: milkyway.chat
products.tagline: One AI chat for all frontier models for a better price.
products.summaryZh: 一个 AI 聊天，汇聚所有前沿模型，价格更优。
products.descriptionZh: 别再为AI多付钱了。无需再付20美元订阅费。不用再为多个AI订阅付费。Milkyway把所有前沿模型放进一个聊天里。• 图像生成 • 实时网络搜索、文件和图像上传 • 语音聊天和MCP连接器 • 自带API密钥，只为功能和服务器成本付费：每月1.99美元 • 套餐每月9美元起，随时取消
products.description: Stop overpaying for AI. No more 20$ Subscriptions. Stop paying for multiple AI subscriptions. Milkyway puts all frontier models in one chat. • image generation • Live web search, file and image uploads • Voice chat and MCP connectors • Bring your own API key, pay only for features and server-costs: $1.99/month • Plans from $9/month, cancel anytime

products.name: Groundbox
products.tagline: Linux sandboxes for agents + faster, cheaper CI. One key.
products.summaryZh: 面向智能体的 Linux 沙箱，以及更快、更省成本的 CI。一个密钥。
products.descriptionZh: 让你的 AI 代理拥有自己的 Linux 虚拟机：约一秒即可启动，暂停和分叉时保留内存，每 vCPU 小时 0.04 美元且包含内存。同一密钥还能以 GitHub 一半的价格运行你的 GitHub Actions，一个 PR 就能看出快多少。免费开始。
products.description: Give your AI agents their own Linux VMs: they start in about a second, pause and fork with memory kept, and cost $0.04 per vCPU-hour with memory included. Same key runs your GitHub Actions at half GitHub's price, and one PR shows how much faster. Free to start.

products.name: LikeRemote
products.tagline: Find a job faster. Hire real people, not bots.
products.summaryZh: 更快找到工作。雇用真人，而非机器人。
products.descriptionZh: 求职招聘两端都已失灵。求职者在不同招聘网站间来回跳转，反复填写相同信息上百次，却得不到任何回音。招聘方则被机器人投递的AI撰写简历淹没。LikeRemote同时解决这两个问题。求职者能在一个地方找到适合自己的职位，一键投递，并通过短视频脱颖而出。招聘方只接触到经过验证的真实人选，优先看到最匹配的候选人，也不会错失优秀申请者。首次发布职位免费。
products.description: Job hunting is broken on both sides. Job seekers jump between job boards, type the same answers a hundred times, and hear nothing back. Recruiters drown in AI-written CVs sent by bots. LikeRemote fixes both. Job seekers find the jobs that fit them in one place, apply in one click, and stand out with a short video. Recruiters meet only verified, real people, see the best fit first, and never lose a good applicant. Your first job post is free.

products.name: GeoAlarm
products.tagline: Fell asleep on the bus? Wake up at your stop
products.summaryZh: 在公交车上睡着了？到站时叫醒你
products.descriptionZh: GeoAlarm 是一款免费的 Android 闹钟，它根据你所在的位置响铃，而不是根据时间。在地图上选好你的下车站点，锁上手机打个盹：当你接近该地点时它就会响铃，即使屏幕关闭、应用已关闭也不例外。移动闹钟会在有人拿起你的手机或包时响铃，高度闹钟则利用气压计在设定的高度响铃。无需账户，无广告，支持 30 种语言。你的闹钟和位置数据保留在你的手机上。
products.description: GeoAlarm is a free Android alarm that rings based on where you are, not what time it is. Pick your stop on the map, lock your phone and doze off: it rings when you get close, even with the screen off and the app closed. Motion alarms ring if someone picks up your phone or bag, and altitude alarms use the barometer to ring at a set height. No account, no ads, 30 languages. Your alarms and location stay on your phone.

products.name: Dayglass
products.tagline: Bot-free meeting notes on your Mac, readable by Claude Code
products.summaryZh: Mac 上无机器人干扰的会议记录，Claude Code 可读取
products.descriptionZh: Dayglass 是 Mac 上专为你的工作日打造的私密 AI 记忆。它无需机器人加入即可录制 Zoom、Teams 和 Google Meet，将音频、屏幕和笔记保存在你的 Mac 上，并让 Claude Code 和 Cursor 通过 MCP 读取你的实时通话，因此你的智能体在通话仍在进行时就能知道已做出的决定。前 10 次会议免费，无需信用卡。支持 macOS 13+、Apple Silicon。
products.description: Dayglass is a private AI memory for your work day on Mac. It records Zoom, Teams and Google Meet without a bot joining, keeps audio, screen and notes on your Mac, and lets Claude Code and Cursor read your live call over MCP, so your agent knows what was decided while the call is still happening. Free for your first 10 meetings, no card. macOS 13+, Apple Silicon.

products.name: Peck
products.tagline: Woodpecker Method chess training, built from your own games
products.summaryZh: 啄木鸟训练法国际象棋训练，基于你自己的对局构建
products.descriptionZh: Peck 是一款免费的 Woodpecker Method 训练工具：先建立一组国际象棋谜题，然后在计时循环中反复解答，直到模式牢固掌握。它可以根据你在自己的 Lichess 或 Chess.com 对局中错过的战术来建立题集，并免费逐着复盘任何对局。错题队列、每周联赛、好友、排名、关联等级分和开局题集让你有理由回来。无广告。Peck Pro 为可选。
products.description: Peck is a free trainer for the Woodpecker Method: build a set of chess puzzles, then solve it again in timed cycles until the patterns stick. It can build the set from the tactics you missed in your own Lichess or Chess.com games, and it reviews any game move by move for free. A missed-puzzle queue, weekly leagues, friends, ranks, linked ratings and opening sets give you reasons to come back. No ads. Peck Pro is optional.
